title: Finite reduction of the specified completed Cartier arrow
statement: Let l be prime, Y,P=ProjectiveLine Y,W=diagonalSurface Y Noetherian with l invertible on Y and the three DiagonalTraceLocalizations. Supply a derived completion reduction D, its completion and cycle-system specifications, a completed diagonal arrow delta satisfying IsDiagonalLimit, a coefficient Family and a Reference to delta [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. Let E be a finite intermediate field, pi generate the maximal ideal of O_E, n be natural, and A=ULift(O_E/(pi)^(n+1)) be finite and killed by l^(n+1), with this exponent invertible on Y and W. Supply a quotient Diagram d and ScalarCompatibility from family.integral E to d. Supply finite realizations eP,eW [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-realization], a positive-root-normalized QuotientLineRealization lineW [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-quotient-line], and a supported-source isomorphism whose underlying map is exactly direct image of eP's specified coefficient-unit comparison. Then conjugating the image of d.delta through that source isomorphism, the exact single/shift comparisons, and lineW.iso gives exactly finiteCartierArrow A (l^(n+1)) Y, the canonical positive Cartier extension arrow [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-finite-diagonal]. This concludes only the class equation, with the endpoints already given; it asserts neither their existence nor any trace equation.

proof.text: Obtain the cyclic frame p and its Cartier class equality from diagonalCompleted_cyclicCartier, using the supplied whole-arrow Reference and IsDiagonalLimit.

Apply geoCartierCanonicalClass_scalar to the canonical cyclic and quotient classes. Extract its normalized eta,theta and the derived base-change unit on the supported source. Apply diagonalCyclic_uniformizerSquare to family.toIntegral, scalar and the same eta,theta.

Transport the coefficient square along the cyclic class equality by congrArg. Apply class_eq_of_scalar_square to compare this square with the canonical scalar square. That proved cancellation lemma uses the supported unit and the degree-two Ext bijection to identify the quotient classes. Apply Ext.homEquiv and its inverse identity to obtain exactly FiniteCartierArrowEquation.

proof_origin.note: The proof separates the cyclic completed projection and coefficient continuation, then proves equality using the supported scalar-unit Ext bijection. No full-arrow detection from separate finite reductions is used.

theorem diagonalUniformizer_cartierReduction
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalDerivedReduction l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (hcompletion : DiagonalCompletionSpec l (diagonalSurface Y) D)
    (hsystem : DiagonalCycleSystemSpec l Y hY D)
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (hδ : DiagonalTrace.IsDiagonalLimit l Y hY D δ)
    (family : Family l Y) (reference : Reference l Y δ family)
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers l E)) (n : ℕ)
    [hfinite : Finite (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n))]
    (hA : ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) = 0)
    (hYpow : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (hWpow : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(diagonalSurface Y, ⊤)))
    (d : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      Y (quotientLine l E π n))
    (scalar : ScalarCompatibility (quotientMap l E π n) Y
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (quotientLine l E π n)
      (quotientLineMap l E π n) (family.integral E) d)
    (eP : FiniteRealization
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (eW : FiniteRealization
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) (diagonalSurface Y))
    (lineW : QuotientLineRealization l E π n n hA (diagonalSurface Y) eW)
    (sourceComparison : FiniteSourceComparison
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) Y eP eW) :
    FiniteCartierArrowEquation
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (l ^ (n + 1)) (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) hA Y hWpow
      (quotientLine l E π n) d eW (lineW.iso l) sourceComparison.iso
